total.description: Vendor and product pairs that hold the search text, before paging.

limit.description: Most items in results: the limit argument, 20 by default.

offset.description: Items skipped: the offset argument, 0 by default.

next_offset.description: offset plus this page's items; total on the last page.

product.description: CPE escapes kept, such as notepad\+\+.

vulnerable_cve_count.description: CVEs that mark the pair vulnerable. 0 when CVEs name the pair only as not vulnerable: a vendor or product filter then finds no CVE.

product_named_by.description: Who named the pair: nvd (an NVD CPE configuration), cna_cpe (a CPE name the CNA gave) or cna (the CNA's free text), each at most once.

results.description: Highest vulnerable_cve_count first. Pass vendor and product as they are, escapes included, to the vendor and product arguments of other tools.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
